title: Satisfaction under addition of a satisfied equation
statement:
Let $
u$ be a finite set, let $L_1,L_2$ be linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$ on $
u$, and let $x\colon
u	o\mathbb{F}_2$ be an assignment satisfying $L_2$. Then $x$ satisfies the sum of $L_1$ and $L_2$ if and only if it satisfies $L_1$.
hypotheses_covered: The assignment satisfies the right-hand equation
